title: Fix AutoFix Suggested Fix section absent from findings drawer when ai.autofix_enabled=false
goal: Add an AutoFix section to the findings drawer that: (a) when ai.autofix_enabled=false shows a compact 'AutoFix is disabled - enable in Settings > AI Provider' with a direct Settings link; (b) when ai.autofix_enabled=true and ai_fix_suggestion exists renders the suggestion with the advisory review/testing disclaimer from backlog-131; (c) when ai.autofix_enabled=true but no suggestion shows 'No suggestion available - re-run with AutoFix enabled'. Never auto-apply code. Use existing FindingRemediation.ai_fix_suggestion field - no new API endpoints needed.
scope: Walkthrough 2026-04-30: The finding drawer has no AutoFix section at all. backlog-131 was completed and the ai_fix_suggestion field exists on FindingRemediation, but the drawer only shows the manual Remediation section. The default setting ai.autofix_enabled=false means no suggestions are generated. The drawer should at minimum surface that AutoFix is a feature and is currently off.
